messages.sourceEnglish: Compare a fixed US station’s weather observations with clear dates and missing readings.
messages.text: Bapisa litebello tsa boemo ba leholimo tsa seteishene se sa fetoheng sa US ka matsatsi a hlakileng le lipalo tse sieo.

messages.sourceEnglish: Review a public US weather station
messages.text: Hlahloba seteishene sa boemo ba leholimo sa sechaba sa US

messages.sourceEnglish: Choose United States, then load the fixed public station example. Observation and retrieval times stay separate; this does not supply farm weather or planting advice.
messages.text: Khetha United States, ebe u kenya mohlala oa seteishene sa sechaba se sa fetoheng. Linako tsa ho shebella le tsa ho lata li lula li arohane; sena ha se fane ka boemo ba leholimo ba polasi kapa keletso ea ho jala.
